module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  j,
    input  k,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else case (state)
            2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; if (j) state <= 2'b01; end
            2'b01: begin out <= 1'b1; if (k) state <= 2'b10; end
            2'b10: begin out <= 1'b1; if (!k) state <= 2'b10; end
            2'b11: begin out <= 1'b0; if (!j) state <= 2'b00; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  areset,
    input  j,
    input  k,
    output reg out
);
    reg [1:0] state;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (areset) state <= 2'b00;
        else
            case (state)
                2'b00: begin out <= 1'b0; if (j) state <= 2'b01; end
                2'b01: begin out <= 1'b1; if (k) state <= 2'b10; else if (j) state <= 2'b01; end
                2'b10: begin out <= 1'b1; if (k) state <= 2'b00; else if (!j) state <= 2'b10; end
                default: state <= 2'b00;
            endcase
    end
endmodule
